description: Cancels one of the homeowner's quote requests and notifies the contractor. If the contractor already sent a quote that is still open, that quote is declined. Requests whose quote was accepted are jobs and cannot be cancelled here. Confirm with the homeowner first. Calling it again for a cancelled request changes nothing. Requires a linked RateDeed account (scope quotes:write).

request_id.description: Request ID to cancel, e.g. QR-7K2M9QXD4T.

name: cancel_request
title: Cancel a quote request
